channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Supreme Court lets White House continue construction on Trump's $400 million ballroom
item.description: A divided Supreme Court on Monday allowed the White House to continue construction on a $400 million ballroom project as lawsuits play out.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Too late' for Trump to make major changes to how mail-in voting works, expert says
item.description: "Mail voting is almost certainly going to proceed in 2026 as it always has for voters," said David Becker, the executive director for the nonpartisan Center of Election Innovation and Research.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] About 80 Americans remain unaccounted for after devastating flash flooding in Nepal
item.description: Approximately 80 Americans are among the more than 4,400 people unaccounted for following catastrophic flash flooding that swept through Nepal and its border with China, according to a U.S. State Department spokesperson.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pinellas County study underway for East Lake Road corridor to manage growing traffic, construction to come
item.description: Pinellas County is conducting a study on traffic patterns along the East Lake Road corridor and how they are expected to change over the next 20 years.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Nicolás Maduro shares photos on his social media from inside New York prison
item.description: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro shared photos on his X account from the prison in New York where he has been held since the U.S. military captured him and his wife in January.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Kalshi bans ex-Congressman George Santos for life, alleging insider trading
item.description: The online prediction market platform Kalshi said Monday that it has permanently banned former U.S. Rep. George Santos for his bets on whether he'd attend the State of the Union address.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman arrested in Hillsborough County on drug trafficking charge after meth found in vehicle: HCSO
item.description: Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office (HCSO) said a woman and a man were arrested on drug charges after being pulled over for a traffic stop.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Support program could be helping former inmates stay out of prison
item.description: A new Indiana University study found incarcerated people with traumatic brain injuries were far less likely to return to prison when they received education, coping skills training and post-release support.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Many consumers are likely to switch insurance companies because of slow payouts
item.description: According to InvoiceCloud’s 2026 Consumer Claims Experiences Survey, about 15-percent of people say they got their claim payment within a week

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bucs QB Baker Mayfield, his wife Emily continue making a difference in Tampa Bay community
item.description: The "Be the Ball" charity golf event benefits the Early Learning Coalition of Hillsborough County, helping children access early education regardless of family income.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Recent study finds those shopping around with loan offers can save significantly
item.description: A recent LendingTree study has found that borrowers who compare multiple loan offers can save significantly over the life of a loan.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Fed report finds rising gas prices have lasting effect on inflation expectations
item.description: A new report from the San Francisco Federal Reserve Bank shows U.S. household inflation expectations rise when expecting higher gas prices, but remain relatively unchanged when prices at the pump drop.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Sarasota police issue 4 school-zone speeding violations to same driver
item.description: Sarasota police are reminding drivers to slow down in school zones after the same vehicle was caught speeding four times in four days, according to the Sarasota Police Department (SPD).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Millennials, Gen Z set to inherit trillions — but most aren't prepared for the tax implications
item.description: Millennials and Gen Z are set to inherit up to $100 trillion — but are they ready for the tax bill that could come with it? An expert breaks down what you need to know. 💰

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bartender takes on Pasco sheriff in unusual State Senate race
item.description: Jordan Hensley says he decided to run after realizing no Democrat had stepped forward to challenge Chris Nocco for the open seat.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Human remains found in wooded area of Homosassa: CCSO
item.description: Citrus County deputies are investigating after human remains were discovered on Sunday in a wooded area near the end of West Elkhorn Drive in Homosassa, according to the Citrus Co. Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Is it safe to eat lettuce yet? What to know as cyclosporiasis outbreak lingers
item.description: As federal health officials continue to investigate this summer’s outbreak of cyclosporiasis tied to iceberg lettuce, many people are left wondering: Is it safe to eat lettuce yet?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Recall issued for this mango brand due to possible Salmonella contamination
item.description: A recall has been issued for more than 300 boxes of mangoes because they may be contaminated with Salmonella.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bradenton man extradited from Hungary on child exploitation charge: BPD
item.description: A Bradenton man who fled to Hungary to avoid arrest in 2022 has been extradited back to Florida on child exploitation charges, the Bradenton Police Department (BPD) said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Open books can open doors for local students
item.description: Each fall, our station supports the Scripps Howard Fund’s “If You Give a Child a Book …” campaign. Donations to the campaign directly benefit children in our community, allowing them to pick new books to build their home libraries.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New report shows the world's coral reefs are declining rapidly
item.description: There have been four global coral bleaching events recorded since 1998. This is the process in which stressed corals expel microscopic algae, turning completely white.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa Bay contractor tracked down by I-Team after clients win judgments for unfinished work
item.description: Real estate investor Adam Turem hired Jeremiah Klotz and his company, GLK Construction, in 2022 to renovate a 100-year-old Tampa house.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump's foreign beef deal draws skepticism from farmers and cattle ranchers nationwide
item.description: Trump's plan to import foreign beef at 25% below market value isn't sitting well with cattle farmers. Will the savings even reach your grocery cart? 🛒

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lightning strike fire displaced 167 residents at Wesley Chapel apartment complex: Cobalt
item.description: More than 160 residents were displaced after a lightning strike sparked a massive fire at a Wesley Chapel apartment complex earlier this month, according to a statement released by Cobalt Apartments.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 2-day festival 'Dollyfest' announced to celebrate the late country icon's legacy
item.description: The celebration of country music icon Dolly Parton is far from over, after a two-day festival was announced across two weekends in 2027.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lionel Messi says he's retiring from playing for Argentina
item.description: Lionel Messi has ended his career as a player for the Argentine national team at 39 years old, after nearly two decades representing the national side.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US Treasury blocks certain journalists from G20 meeting in North Carolina
item.description: The U.S. Treasury Department is preventing certain journalists from covering a finance meeting among the world's most powerful countries.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] DEA tactic that let fentanyl flood the streets is now being investigated
item.description: A controversial policing tactic that permitted staggering amounts of fentanyl to reach the streets as federal authorities sought to build bigger drug cases is now under investigation.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: Are you prepared for the surge in Medicare scams?
item.description: Open enrollment hasn't started yet — but scammers already have your number. One retired beneficiary got more than a dozen calls in a single day. Here's how to protect yourself.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FDA expands Mounjaro approval for heart attack and stroke prevention
item.description: The FDA just expanded approval of Mounjaro to help prevent heart attacks and strokes in people with type 2 diabetes. Here's what you need to know about the new indication. 🔗

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa International Airport's Red Departures drive closure: What travelers need to know
item.description: Travelers being dropped off at Tampa International Airport’s Red Departures Side will have to take a temporary detour beginning Monday.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Friends, family plant tree at USF honoring nursing student killed by wrong-way driver
item.description: USF students, family and friends gathered on campus Monday to plant an evergreen oak tree honoring Lauryn Akey, a nursing student killed by a wrong-way drunk driver in May.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Van fire causes major delays on Sunshine Skyway Bridge: FHP
item.description: A Verizon work van caught fire Monday morning on the Sunshine Skyway Bridge, prompting the closure of multiple northbound lanes, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Illegal immigrant arrested in Polk County sexual battery, home invasion
item.description: An illegal immigrant was arrested in Polk County after deputies said he attacked and sexually battered an elderly woman in her Mulberry home.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk man arrested, accused of attacking pregnant woman: PCSO
item.description: A man was arrested after Polk County deputies said he grabbed a pregnant woman by the neck and pushed her to the floor Sunday night near Lakeland.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Cobalt Apartments fire: 167 displaced, residents 'highly unlikely' to retrieve belongings
item.description: The Cobalt Apartments in Wesley Chapel provided an update Monday on the Aug. 20 fire that destroyed one of its buildings, saying 83 occupied apartments were impacted. The complex said 167 residents were displaced and it's "highly unlikely" they will be able to retrieve personal belongings from the building.
